claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-fixed-g1-invert-g2 target, the STNFS algorithm of proof.md and DESCENT.md returns Q with e(P,Q)=z for the exact supplied nonidentity P with success at least 0.39 (modelled >= 0.391889) under the heuristics H1-H5 of proof.md section 9, and a global meter bounds all classical work, preprocessing included and nothing amortized, by 2^121.239700 dense-Fp12 units (C = 20,000 instructions); the ledger is proof.md section 8. Analytic exploratory claim, not a full-size run.

experiments.purpose: Recomputes certificates, pool, region, yield, cost, ledger, linear algebra, descent and every declared bound. quick=true skips the supporting audits [6], [6b], [11], [11b], [12] (listed as skipped) to fit the 20 s run; quick=false runs them (about 30 s).

Rerun the package's filtering simulation (filtsim.py) to mean weight 100 or 200 (default 200) and report the fraction of row weight carried by +-1 entries (against the charged 0.88) and U/N. Optional (the hosted initial run is the bounded audit). Evidence at its scale only; production is extrapolated (H4u, H3).
